stations.title: Rhona
stations.say: Why does it say Cairn Dubh?

stations.title: Monthly report
stations.text: Names a busiest hill, and no error at all.

stations.title: Rhona
stations.note: And it cannot go quiet again.

captions: At the base, Rhona asks why the monthly report names Cairn Dubh as the busiest hill.
Today the report names the wrong hill, and nothing stops to say so.
You cut the log down, print what busiest_hill sees, mend it and add an assert.
Now the report names Scarth Fell, the hill the team counted four callouts on.
Rhona sends a report she can trust, and an empty log now stops with words that say why.
